reason: FTB Quests 2001.4.22 reads IDs with the signed Long.parseLong(hex, 16) (BaseQuestFile.readID, QuestLink.readData, ThemeLoader selectors). IDs 8000000000000000..FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF fail: objects get a random ID at every load, a quest link crashes the server (log of 2026-10-23).
rule: ID with the top bit set: the same digits with the top bit cleared (first hex digit minus 8). Tasks and rewards generated from a renumbered quest get new generated IDs. No new ID equals an Alpha 42 or earlier Alpha 43 ID; Alpha 42 IDs below 8000000000000000 are unchanged.
